messages:
nora (product): Quick planning thread: we need a concise, audit-friendly rollout for MultiTierFallbacks. Customers want opt-ins, clear metrics, and rollback SLAs. Can we decide slices, gating signals, and who owns what?

ezra (eng): Proposal: three-stage rollout — dogfood -> pilot opt-ins (region aware) -> graduated random ramp. Key additions: per-tenant slow-start, token caps, and a fallback circuit that routes to legacy model group.

samir (sre): Safety-first: must include an automated global kill switch, a per-tenant quarantine path if noisy, and an on-call playbook mapped to the pilot window. Also audit logs for every flag flip.

hana (eng-ml): For quality telemetry, run paired requests (same prompt to v1 & v2) for a sample. Compute embed sim + custom heuristics. If quantized path loses >5% quality on a tenant for 3h, auto-switch that tenant to FP.

rachael (sales): Two enterprise pilots requested (therma-eu, glance-us). They need a 6h rollback SLA and a short runbook showing rollback steps and contacts. Can we commit?

oli (customer-success): We'll collect user feedback via a one-click rating + optional comment linked to request id. Also require a short KB for customers explaining expected behavior during pilot.

nora (product): Draft gates suggestion (must pass before expanding):
- Latency: p95 delta <= 180ms vs baseline
- Errors: +5xxs <= 0.2% over baseline
- Quality: paired-sample pass >= 93% on validation prompts
- Cost: per-token delta <= +12% on pilot traffic

ezra (eng): Flag config sketch (informal): {flag: "mt_fallbacks_v1", stages: [{name: "dogfood",pct:1,tenants:["infra-*"]},{name:"pilot",pct:5,tenants:["opt-in","eu-pilot"]},{name:"ramp",pct:25}], fallback: {on_latency: "route_legacy", on_error: "kill_flag"}}

samir (sre): Automated triggers we want in runbook:
- rollback if p95 delta > 220ms for 10m
- rollback if 5xx > baseline + 0.35% for 5m
- quarantine tenant if token spike > 3x baseline for 10m
- validate fallback succeeds within 30s before widening

hana (eng-ml): A/B plan: shadow full-precision for first 24h and compute sim and length-diff. We'll surface per-tenant flags when thresholds breach. Also ship a small scorer that runs hourly.

rachael (sales): For pilots, we'll include opt-in language + rollback window in the addendum. Need product to draft and CS to approve messaging.

nora (product): Owners: Product drafts pilot addendum + rollout checklist (nora); Eng implements flag, slow-start, fallback route (ezra); SRE builds kill-switch automation + runbook (samir); Eng-ML ships scorer + auto-promote/demote rules (hana); CS/Sales recruit pilots and do comms (oli/rachael).

ezra (eng): I'll add a perf harness and open a PR with the flag stub and slow-start enforcement today.

samir (sre): I'll create the emergency handbook and wire the deploy-bot hook to log canary start/stop + reason.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: mt_fallbacks_v1 phase=pilot pct=5 initiated_by=nora start=1725005400

oli (customer-success): Confirmed pilots: therma-eu (opt-in), glance-us (opt-in). We'll send the one-click feedback link once product drafts the addendum.

hana (eng-ml): I'll provide the scorer and a small dashboard widget: per-tenant sim, p95, and token-delta. Prefer 72h retention for pilot metrics to speed decisions.

nora (product): Final ask: include a short telemetry contract: who owns which metric, where to find it, and SLA for alerts. I'll draft and tag owners in the doc. Aim to start the pilot next Monday.

ezra (eng): PR #4471 created: feature/mt-fallbacks-flag + perf-harness https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot/pull/4471

samir (sre): Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/mt-fallbacks-pilot

oli (customer-success): Pilot invites sent; waiting on signed opt-ins from both customers.

nora (product): Thanks team. Keep updates here and attach PR links. If any blocker (cost, infra, or model quality) appears, escalate immediately.
